pass: Tinker Panda — approved Expressive Markings master + website preview preparation
pathConvention: All paths in references and lineage are repository-root relative. Files named without art/ elsewhere are relative to this handoff directory.
method: Copy the selected exported V3.3 front sprite byte-for-byte as the approved master. Render only comparison/handoff canvases with exact integer nearest-neighbor enlargement. No image generation, redraw, recoloring, resizing of the native master or edits to prior work.
generationHistory: The existing V3.3 imagegen face source was generated above native size, sampled over its full canvas to 96 × 96 with nearest-neighbor, mapped to the inherited 19-color palette, then composited as RGB only inside a fixed face mask on the V3.2 baseline. V3.3 retained all original alpha and all RGBA outside the mask. This handoff adopts that existing native export exactly; it does not describe it as a newly hand-drawn pixel master.

lineage.note: Silhouette, compact seated body, upright oversized striped tail and memorable overall shape.
Warm eye clarity, cream muzzle and readable smile informed the V3.2 hybrid.

lineage.role: Selected face export and approved master source

approvalScope: Owner-approved default FRONT design. Website placements remain mockups for review. Other faces, poses, views and animations are not approved.
sourcePreservation: Prior V2.1, V3, V3.2 and V3.3 files are read-only inputs; no prior source, prompt, board or review file is modified.
